title: Obsession Director Releases New Horror Short on YouTube
excerpt: Curry Barker, director of the horror film Obsession, has released a new five-minute horror short film titled Mama Bear on YouTube.
body_html:
Curry Barker, known for directing the horror film Obsession, has released a new horror short film on YouTube. Titled Mama Bear, the new video has a runtime of nearly five minutes.

The short film is described as unnerving with some graphic content, offering a scary watch for fans of the genre.
